'''Cheese Cauliflower''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].  It is shortened to "'''Cheese Cauli.'''" in the stove menu in-game.

Cheese Cauliflower may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. One Cheese Cauliflower may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Bundles==
Cheese Cauliflower is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Cheese Cauliflower is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Toasted Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt249.png|24px]]

==Quests==
Cheese Cauliflower is not used in any [[quests]].

==Trivia==
* Cheese Cauliflower benefits from the [[Farming#Farming Skill|Rancher]] profession, increasing the value to 360g and 540g with [[Qi Seasoning]]
